The MAG rows hold assembly type constant. The 503-genome rows add the 260 cultured isolates to the 243 MAGs, which means that they are not restricted to binned genomes. Bakta was run on all 823 ingroup genomes with a retrievable assembly (Table S28), but per-genome pseudogene counts were retained for 503 of them; every pseudogene comparison reported in the paper runs on that panel, which is the one listed per genome in Table S5. Clade medians across the 503: FSM 4 pseudogenes (1.17 per Mb), RGM 9 (1.41), SGM 9 (1.68); the MAG-only SGM median of 18 is inflated by binning.

Without a genome-size offset the comparison is of counts, and a clade whose genomes are half the size is credited with a deficit that is partly arithmetic. With log genome size as an offset the FSM rate ratio is 0.69, and 0.60 once contigs per Mb is included.
